recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Oats & Berries
recipes.ingredients:
80 g rolled oats
150 g plain Greek yogurt
100 g mixed berries
1 tsp honey
recipes.instructions: Combine oats, yogurt, berries. Drizzle honey.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
150 g cooked chicken breast
200 g cooked jasmine rice
100 g steamed broccoli
1 tbsp olive oil
recipes.instructions: Bowl up chicken, rice, broccoli; finish with olive oil.

recipes.title: Salmon, Quinoa & Greens
recipes.ingredients:
150 g baked salmon
180 g cooked quinoa
100 g mixed greens
lemon wedge
recipes.instructions: Bake salmon, plate with quinoa and greens; squeeze lemon.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese & Fruit
recipes.ingredients:
200 g low-fat cottage cheese
150 g pineapple chunks
